title.narrative: Strengthening Media and Information Literacy in Pacific SIDS

description.narrative: UNESCO will strengthen the capacities of media organizations and journalist networks in Pacific SIDS to address disinformation and promote trustworthy, science-based information, with a particular focus on climate-related information disorder. Activities will include adapting UNESCO MIL resources to the Pacific context, supporting training and exchanges for media professionals on information integrity and climate disinformation, and strengthening partnerships with journalism schools and regional media actors. The workplan will contribute to reinforcing ethical journalism, public trust in media, and resilience against harmful online content in the Pacific region.
